regeln: Ensure all selected visual clips and images strictly match the historical, geographical, and narrative context without appearing generic or stock-photo-like.
Verify that characters, settings, and time periods depicted in visuals accurately reflect the specific details mentioned in the voiceover.
Start every video with a highly visual, specific, and engaging hook instead of generic imagery.
Design the call-to-action to blend smoothly into the final seconds to create a seamless loop.
Maintain early momentum in the story by avoiding dense historical context, biographical filler, or excessive background information in the opening sentences.
Pace the narrative by removing overly specific dates, years, and multiple locations that disrupt the flow of short-form videos.
Preserve the curiosity gap in the opening hook by avoiding giving away the core twist immediately.
